metadata.cache_warning: The first arm of a group reads the checkpoint cold from SSD and later arms find part of it in the page cache, so order alone changes the timing (a page-cache effect once inflated a smoke ratio to 1.55x). With fewer than 3 rounds in reversed order this is not a speed measurement: do not read an F0 versus F2 speed ratio from it. Free memory and page-in counters are recorded per arm to show the cache state.
